cases.json:results: every consumer in evidence has a ledger row
ledger.json:rows: the ledger's totals agree with its rows

cases.json:ablations.validator: run.py:116 compares observed_break against the declared expect_breaks

cases.json:results.validator: assertions/arrays.py:compare() decides each verdict; run.py:run_case records it
cases.json:results.writer: sharded.py:main() for the shipped lane; run.py:main() when run whole

generated:identity stamps.validator: identity.py:identity() recomputes the tree digest; closure._one_tree compares every stamp to it
generated:identity stamps.writer: each artifact's own main(): ledger.py:build, sharded.py:112, lanes.py:main, provenance.py:main

generated:ledger.validator: closure.conditions() returns only `ledger present` when the file is absent

lanes.json:lanes.validator: NONE beyond the int parse -- the exit code is the shell's, and nothing re-derives it
lanes.json:lanes.writer: compat.just `run` appends `<lane> <code>` per lane; lanes.py:_recorded parses it

ledger.json:consumed.validator: closure._consumption_agrees re-digests each named artifact and compares
ledger.json:consumed.writer: ledger.py:_read records a sha256 at every open build() performs

ledger.json:rows.validator: ledger.py:stages_are_covered() + STAGE_EVIDENCE: each cell derives from its own case field
ledger.json:rows.writer: ledger.py:build() -- one row per manifest consumer

provenance.json:weights.validator: provenance.weight_is_verified() -- the one predicate closure and ledger now share
provenance.json:weights.writer: provenance.py:weight_identity() -> main(), state from weight_state() at :505-517
